name: make_api_call
label: Make an API call
description: Performs an arbitrary authenticated call against the Firmaradar API for endpoints the dedicated modules do not cover. It cannot call DPA-gated AML endpoints; use the dedicated AML modules, which collect the required purpose and confirmation. Takes a relative path, an HTTP method and optional headers, query string and body, and returns the status code, response headers and body.

parameters.name: url
parameters.label: Path after /api/
parameters.help: Path AFTER the /api/ prefix, which is added automatically — for example v1/company/923609016 or regnskap/923609016/historikk. Every Firmaradar endpoint lives under /api/. Dot segments are rejected in both literal ('.', '..') and percent-encoded (%2e) form: URL normalisation treats both as parent segments, which would resolve out of the /api/ prefix.

validate.patternErrorMessage: Enter the path after /api/, with no leading slash or backslash, no '.' or '..' segments, and no percent-encoded dots (%2e). Example: v1/company/923609016.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.label: Headers
parameters.help: Extra request headers. Authorization and the Make/DPA control headers are set or protected by the app and cannot be supplied here. DPA-gated AML endpoints must use the dedicated AML modules.

parameters.name: qs
parameters.label: Query string
parameters.help: Query-string parameters, added to any already present in the path.

parameters.name: body
parameters.label: Body
parameters.help: Request body for POST, PUT and PATCH. Ignored for GET and DELETE.

communication.//:
SECURITY, presist om hva prefikset faktisk garanterer.
Det fikse '/api/'-prefikset garanterer ORIGIN: en ledende '/' eller '\\' i brukerens verdi kan aldri gi en protokoll-relativ referanse, fordi '//' bare er protokoll-relativt i STARTEN av referansen. '\\evil.example/x' blir '/api/\\evil.example/x' → '/api//evil.example/x', altså fortsatt vår egen vert. Authorization-headeren kan derfor ikke sendes til en server brukeren velger.
🪤 Prefikset alene garanterer IKKE at kallet holder seg innenfor /api/. '../ext/...' kan normaliseres utenfor prefikset, og Make kan la en MAPPET verdi hoppe over UI-valideringen. Denne modulen sender derfor alltid den faste X-FR-Make-Module: universal-markøren gjennom universalApiHeaders(); backend avviser enhver slik forespørsel hvis den normaliserte stien ikke starter med /api/. Det er den serverhåndhevede markør-gaten — ikke validate-mønsteret — som gir strukturell inneslutning. Punktsegmenter avvises fortsatt i UI for tydelig brukerfeil, i begge former (%2e og . / ..).
